*User retention: Q3 2026 (Jul–Sep signup cohorts)*
• 354 new users. Active in days 1–7: *97.7%*. Days 8–14: *61.9%*. Days 15–30: *68.9%*
• By month (D8–14 / D15–30): 2026-07 62.8% / 69.4%, 2026-08 61.9% / 70.3%, 2026-09 60.9% / 67%
• Retention = any event in that window after signup. Source: users_data.
